title: Article 167 — Duties of Chief Minister as respects the furnishing of information to Governor, etc.

content.overview: Article 167 imposes duties on the Chief Minister: to communicate to the Governor all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to the administration of the affairs of the State and proposals for legislation; to furnish such information relating to the administration of the affairs of the State and proposals for legislation as the Governor may call for; and, if the Governor so requires, to submit for the consideration of the Council of Ministers any matter on which a decision has been taken by a Minister but which has not been considered by the Council.
content.glance: CM must: communicate CoM decisions to Governor; furnish information Governor calls for; submit Minister-only decisions to CoM if Governor requires. Parallel to Art 78.
content.study:
Article 167 is the State counterpart of Article 78. It supports the Governor’s formal role and the collective character of the Council of Ministers.

Examination: three duties; parallel to Art 78.

sections.heading: Three duties
sections.body:
1. Communicate CoM decisions (administration + legislative proposals) to the Governor.
2. Furnish information the Governor calls for.
3. On Governor’s requirement: submit Minister-only decisions to the Council of Ministers.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What are the duties of the Chief Minister under Article 167?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 167, it is the duty of the Chief Minister to communicate to the Governor all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to the administration of the affairs of the State and proposals for legislation; to furnish such information relating to those matters as the Governor may call for; and, if the Governor so requires, to submit for the consideration of the Council of Ministers any matter on which a decision has been taken by a Minister but which has not been considered by the Council.

examTips: Parallel to Art 78; CM’s information and referral duties to Governor.

keyTakeaways: Art 167: CM’s duties to inform and report to the Governor.
